record_title: Sumset growth from the first Kunz layer at prime multiplicity
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The explicit Cauchy-Davenport layer bound requires prime multiplicity; the general sumset-containment statement does not. The Wilf criterion is sufficient rather than necessary and does not resolve Wilf's conjecture in full. Very recent or incompletely indexed follow-up work to the 2026 first-layer preprint remains a residual originality risk. No independent validation is asserted.
